syntax.description: Takes input and produces it unchanged as output.
Object identifier-index. Produces the value at key "foo", or null if absent. .foo.bar is equivalent to .foo | .bar. Only works for identifier-like keys.
Like .foo but suppresses errors when the input is not an object.
Object index by string key, e.g. .["foo"]. Works for any string, including non-identifier-like keys.
Array index by integer, zero-based. Negative indices count from the end.
Array/string slice, returning a subarray or substring. Either bound may be omitted or negative.
Array/object value iterator. Produces all elements of an array or all values of an object as separate outputs (generator).
Like .[] but suppresses errors if the input is not an array or object.
Comma operator. Feeds the same input to both filters and concatenates their output streams; a generator.
Pipe operator. Feeds each output of a as input to b.
Parenthesis used purely for grouping.
Array construction. Collects all outputs of EXP into a single array.
Object construction. Shorthand forms: {a} for {a: .a}, {$a} for {a: $a}, {(expr): val} for computed keys.
Recursive descent. Produces every value reachable by recursing into ., equivalent to recurse.
String interpolation. Embeds the value produced by EXP into a string literal.
Format string. Applies a @format encoding (e.g. @csv, @base64) to interpolated values inside a string literal.

syntax.form: if A then B elif C then D else E end
syntax.description: Conditional. Evaluates B if A is not false/null, else checks further elif branches, else E. else/elif branches are optional and default to identity.
Error handling. Runs EXP; if it raises an error, runs HANDLER with the error value as input. 'try EXP' alone uses empty as the handler.
Shorthand for 'try EXP', suppressing any error raised by EXP.
Accumulates all outputs of EXP into a single result, starting from INIT and applying UPDATE for each value of $var.
Like reduce but emits an intermediate result (via EXTRACT, default identity) for each value produced.
Defines a named filter. Parameters are passed as filters (callbacks); prefix a parameter with $ to bind it as a value instead.
Variable binding. Binds each output of EXP to $var while keeping the original input flowing through '...'.
Destructuring binding using array/object patterns, e.g. . as {a: $x, b: [$y]} | ...
Destructuring alternative operator. Tries PATTERN1; on structural or downstream error falls back to PATTERN2. Unmatched variables bind to null.
Named lexical label/break. 'break $out' causes the nearest enclosing 'label $out' to act as though it produced empty. Commonly used to exit reduce/foreach/while early.
Line comment. Everything from # to end of line is ignored; a trailing odd number of backslashes continues the comment onto the next line.
Module import, prefixing the module's symbols with name::.
Module include, merging the module's symbols directly into the caller's namespace.
Imports a JSON file's data as $name::name.
Optional directive attaching metadata to the current module, readable via modulemeta.

operators.description: Pipe: feeds output of left into input of right.
Comma: concatenates output streams of both sides.
Plain assignment: sets paths on the left to values produced by the right.
Update-assignment: sets paths on the left by running their current value through the right-hand filter.
Arithmetic update-assignment, equivalent to a |= . + b.
Arithmetic update-assignment, equivalent to a |= . - b.
Arithmetic update-assignment, equivalent to a |= . * b.
Arithmetic update-assignment, equivalent to a |= . / b.
Arithmetic update-assignment, equivalent to a |= . % b.
Arithmetic update-assignment, equivalent to a |= . // b.

operators.name: or
operators.description: Boolean or. False/null are falsy; produces true/false only.

operators.name: and
operators.description: Boolean and. False/null are falsy; produces true/false only.
Alternative operator: produces left-hand outputs that are not false/null, else falls back to right-hand outputs.
Equality comparison. Strict, no implicit type conversion.
Inequality comparison.
Less-than comparison, using jq's total value ordering.
Less-than-or-equal comparison.
Greater-than comparison.
Greater-than-or-equal comparison.
Addition. Numbers add, arrays/strings concatenate, objects merge (right wins on key conflict), null is identity.
Subtraction. Numeric subtraction, or array difference (removes elements of right from left).
Multiplication. Numeric product, string repetition by number, or recursive object merge.
Division. Numeric division, or string split when dividing string by string.
Modulo on numbers.
Error suppression operator, shorthand for 'try EXP'.

operators.name: as
operators.description: Binds outputs of the left expression to a variable/pattern for use in the following pipeline.
Destructuring alternative operator used within 'as' pattern lists.

operators.name: not
operators.description: Boolean negation, called as a filter (e.g. .foo | not) rather than special syntax.

builtins.name: length
builtins.description: String: codepoint count. Number: absolute value. Array: element count. Object: key count. null: 0. Error on boolean.

builtins.name: utf8bytelength
builtins.description: Number of bytes used to encode the string in UTF-8.

builtins.name: abs
builtins.description: Absolute value of a number.

builtins.name: keys
builtins.description: Object: sorted array of keys. Array: array of valid indices (0..length-1).

builtins.name: keys_unsorted
builtins.description: Like keys, but for objects the keys are in insertion order rather than sorted.

builtins.name: has
builtins.description: Whether the input object has the given key, or the input array has an element at the given index.

builtins.name: in
builtins.description: Inverse of has: whether the input key/index is present in the given object/array.

builtins.name: map
builtins.description: Applies f to each value of .[] and collects all outputs into an array. Equivalent to [.[] | f].

builtins.name: map_values
builtins.description: Like map, but keeps the input's shape (array or object) and uses only the first output of f per value; equivalent to .[] |= f.

builtins.name: pick
builtins.description: Projects the input down to only the given path expressions.

builtins.name: path
builtins.description: Outputs the array representation (keys/indices) of the given path expression evaluated against .

builtins.name: del
builtins.description: Removes the key/index (and value) named by the path expression.

builtins.name: getpath
builtins.description: Outputs the value found at the given path (array of keys/indices) in .

builtins.name: setpath
builtins.description: Sets the given path in . to value, returning the modified value.

builtins.name: delpaths
builtins.description: Deletes all the given paths (array of path arrays) from .

builtins.name: to_entries
builtins.description: Converts an object into an array of {"key":k,"value":v} entries.

builtins.name: from_entries
builtins.description: Converts an array of key/value entries back into an object. Accepts key/Key/name/Name and value/Value as entry field names.

builtins.name: with_entries
builtins.description: Shorthand for to_entries | map(f) | from_entries.

builtins.name: select
builtins.description: Passes through the input unchanged if cond is true for it, otherwise produces no output.

builtins.name: arrays
builtins.description: Passes through the input only if it is an array.

builtins.name: objects
builtins.description: Passes through the input only if it is an object.

builtins.name: iterables
builtins.description: Passes through the input only if it is an array or object.

builtins.name: booleans
builtins.description: Passes through the input only if it is a boolean.

builtins.name: numbers
builtins.description: Passes through the input only if it is a number.

builtins.name: normals
builtins.description: Passes through the input only if it is a normal number.

builtins.name: finites
builtins.description: Passes through the input only if it is a finite number.

builtins.name: strings
builtins.description: Passes through the input only if it is a string.

builtins.name: nulls
builtins.description: Passes through the input only if it is null.

builtins.name: values
builtins.description: Passes through the input only if it is non-null.

builtins.name: scalars
builtins.description: Passes through the input only if it is not an array or object.

builtins.name: empty
builtins.description: Produces no results at all.

builtins.name: error
builtins.description: Raises an error with the input value, or with the given message. Caught by try/catch.

builtins.name: halt
builtins.description: Stops the jq program immediately with no further output; exit status 0.

builtins.name: halt_error
builtins.description: Stops the program, printing the input raw to stderr with no decoration. Exit code defaults to 5.

builtins.name: $__loc__
builtins.description: Produces an object with the filename and line number where it occurs.

builtins.name: paths
builtins.description: Outputs the paths to all elements in the input (or only those matching node_filter), excluding the root path itself.

builtins.name: leaf_paths
builtins.description: Outputs the paths to all leaf (scalar) values in the input.

builtins.name: add
builtins.description: Combines all elements of the array (or generator) together using the same rules as +. Empty array yields null.

builtins.name: any
builtins.description: True if any element of the input array (or generator output) is truthy / satisfies condition. Empty array yields false.

builtins.name: all
builtins.description: True if all elements of the input array (or generator output) are truthy / satisfy condition. Empty array yields true.

builtins.name: flatten
builtins.description: Flattens nested arrays into a single flat array, optionally only up to depth levels.

builtins.name: range
builtins.description: Generates a stream of numbers from 'from' (default 0) to 'upto' (exclusive), stepping by 'by' (default 1).

builtins.name: floor
builtins.description: Rounds the number down to the nearest integer.

builtins.name: sqrt
builtins.description: Square root of the number.

builtins.name: tonumber
builtins.description: Parses the input as a number; numbers pass through unchanged. Errors on other types or malformed strings.

builtins.name: toboolean
builtins.description: Parses the input as a boolean; booleans pass through unchanged. Errors otherwise.

builtins.name: tostring
builtins.description: Renders the input as a string; strings pass through unchanged, other values are JSON-encoded.

builtins.name: type
builtins.description: Returns the JSON type of the input: null, boolean, number, string, array, or object.

builtins.name: infinite
builtins.description: Returns positive infinity.

builtins.name: nan
builtins.description: Returns a NaN value.

builtins.name: isinfinite
builtins.description: True if the input is infinite.

builtins.name: isnan
builtins.description: True if the input is NaN.

builtins.name: isnormal
builtins.description: True if the input is a normal number (not zero, subnormal, infinite, or NaN).

builtins.name: sort
builtins.description: Sorts the array using jq's total value ordering (null, false, true, numbers, strings, arrays, objects).

builtins.name: sort_by
builtins.description: Sorts the array by comparing the result of path_expression applied to each element.

builtins.name: group_by
builtins.description: Groups elements sharing the same path_expression value into subarrays, sorted by that value.

builtins.name: min
builtins.description: Minimum element of the input array.

builtins.name: max
builtins.description: Maximum element of the input array.

builtins.name: min_by
builtins.description: Element with the smallest value of path_exp.

builtins.name: max_by
builtins.description: Element with the largest value of path_exp.

builtins.name: unique
builtins.description: Sorted array with duplicates removed.

builtins.name: unique_by
builtins.description: Keeps one element per distinct value of path_exp.

builtins.name: reverse
builtins.description: Reverses an array (or string).

builtins.name: contains
builtins.description: True if element is completely contained within the input (substring / subset / sub-object).

builtins.name: indices
builtins.description: Array of indices in . where s occurs.

builtins.name: index
builtins.description: Index of the first occurrence of s in the input.

builtins.name: rindex
builtins.description: Index of the last occurrence of s in the input.

builtins.name: inside
builtins.description: Inverse of contains: true if the input is completely contained within b.

builtins.name: startswith
builtins.description: True if the input string starts with str.

builtins.name: endswith
builtins.description: True if the input string ends with str.

builtins.name: combinations
builtins.description: Outputs all combinations of elements of the arrays in the input array, or n repetitions of the input array.

builtins.name: ltrimstr
builtins.description: Removes the given prefix if present.

builtins.name: rtrimstr
builtins.description: Removes the given suffix if present.

builtins.name: trimstr
builtins.description: Removes the given string from both ends if present.

builtins.name: trim
builtins.description: Trims leading and trailing whitespace.

builtins.name: ltrim
builtins.description: Trims leading whitespace only.

builtins.name: rtrim
builtins.description: Trims trailing whitespace only.

builtins.name: explode
builtins.description: Converts a string into an array of Unicode codepoint numbers.

builtins.name: implode
builtins.description: Inverse of explode: converts an array of codepoints into a string.

builtins.name: split
builtins.description: Splits the input string on a literal separator, or (with two args) on a regex match.

builtins.name: join
builtins.description: Joins array/object values into a string using str as separator; inverse of split.

builtins.name: ascii_downcase
builtins.description: Lowercases ASCII alphabetic characters.

builtins.name: ascii_upcase
builtins.description: Uppercases ASCII alphabetic characters.

builtins.name: while
builtins.description: Repeatedly applies update to . while cond holds, emitting each intermediate value.

builtins.name: repeat
builtins.description: Repeatedly applies exp to ., emitting each value, until an error is raised.

builtins.name: until
builtins.description: Repeatedly applies next to . until cond becomes true, emitting only the final value.

builtins.name: recurse
builtins.description: Emits . and recursively applies f (default .[]?) as long as condition (default true) holds, for extracting values from recursive structures.

builtins.name: walk
builtins.description: Recursively applies f to every component of the input, bottom-up (children before the container itself).

builtins.name: have_literal_numbers
builtins.description: True if this jq build preserves input number literals.

builtins.name: have_decnum
builtins.description: True if jq was built with the decnum literal-preserving numeric backend.

builtins.name: $ENV
builtins.description: Object of environment variables as set when the jq program started.

builtins.name: env
builtins.description: Object representing jq's current environment.

builtins.name: transpose
builtins.description: Transposes a possibly jagged matrix (array of arrays); rows are null-padded to be rectangular.

builtins.name: bsearch
builtins.description: Binary search for x in a sorted input array; returns its index, or a negative insertion point if absent.

builtins.name: tojson
builtins.description: Serializes the input value as a JSON text string.

builtins.name: fromjson
builtins.description: Parses a JSON text string into a value.

builtins.name: @text
builtins.description: Format string: same as tostring.

builtins.name: @json
builtins.description: Format string: serializes the input as JSON.

builtins.name: @html
builtins.description: Format string: HTML/XML-escapes the characters <>&'".

builtins.name: @uri
builtins.description: Format string: percent-encodes reserved URI characters.

builtins.name: @urid
builtins.description: Format string: inverse of @uri, percent-decodes %XX sequences.

builtins.name: @csv
builtins.description: Format string: renders an array as a CSV line.

builtins.name: @tsv
builtins.description: Format string: renders an array as a TSV line.

builtins.name: @sh
builtins.description: Format string: escapes input for use in a POSIX shell command line.

builtins.name: @base64
builtins.description: Format string: base64-encodes the input (RFC 4648).

builtins.name: @base64d
builtins.description: Format string: inverse of @base64, decodes base64 input.

builtins.name: fromdateiso8601
builtins.description: Parses an ISO 8601 datetime string into seconds since the Unix epoch.

builtins.name: todateiso8601
builtins.description: Formats seconds since the Unix epoch as an ISO 8601 datetime string.

builtins.name: fromdate
builtins.description: Parses a datetime string (currently ISO 8601 only) into seconds since the Unix epoch.

builtins.name: todate
builtins.description: Alias for todateiso8601.

builtins.name: now
builtins.description: Current time in seconds since the Unix epoch.

builtins.name: strptime
builtins.description: Parses a string matching a C strptime-style format into broken-down time.

builtins.name: strftime
builtins.description: Formats broken-down time (GMT) using a C strftime-style format.

builtins.name: strflocaltime
builtins.description: Like strftime but using the local timezone.

builtins.name: mktime
builtins.description: Converts broken-down time (as from gmtime/strptime) into seconds since the Unix epoch.

builtins.name: gmtime
builtins.description: Converts seconds since the Unix epoch into broken-down GMT time [year, month(0-based), mday, hour, min, sec, wday, yday].

builtins.name: localtime
builtins.description: Like gmtime but using the local timezone.

builtins.name: INDEX
builtins.description: SQL-style: produces an object keyed by index_expression applied to each value of the stream (or of .[] if stream omitted).

builtins.name: JOIN
builtins.description: SQL-style: joins a stream (or .) against an index $idx using idx_expr as the join key, combining matches with join_expr (default identity array).

builtins.name: IN
builtins.description: SQL-style: true if . (or each value of source) appears in the stream s.

builtins.name: builtins
builtins.description: Returns the list of all builtin filters in the form name/arity.

builtins.name: isempty
builtins.description: True if exp produces no outputs at all.

builtins.name: limit
builtins.description: Extracts up to n outputs from expr.

builtins.name: skip
builtins.description: Skips the first n outputs of expr, emitting the rest.

builtins.name: first
builtins.description: First value produced by expr (or of the input array with no argument).

builtins.name: last
builtins.description: Last value produced by expr (or of the input array with no argument).

builtins.name: nth
builtins.description: The nth value produced by expr (or nth element of the input array). Negative n unsupported for the two-arg form.

builtins.name: input
builtins.description: Reads and outputs one new input value from the input stream.

builtins.name: inputs
builtins.description: Reads and outputs all remaining input values, one by one.

builtins.name: debug
builtins.description: Passes input through unchanged, but writes ["DEBUG:", value] messages to stderr as a side effect.

builtins.name: stderr
builtins.description: Prints the input raw and compact to stderr (no decoration), passing it through unchanged.

builtins.name: input_filename
builtins.description: Name of the file currently being read from, or null.

builtins.name: input_line_number
builtins.description: Line number of the input currently being filtered.

builtins.name: truncate_stream
builtins.description: Truncates the given number of leading path elements from the outputs of a streamed expression.

builtins.name: fromstream
builtins.description: Reassembles full values from a stream expression's [path, leaf] / [path] events.

builtins.name: tostream
builtins.description: Outputs the streamed [path, leaf-value] / [path] form of the input.

builtins.name: modulemeta
builtins.description: Takes a module name and outputs its metadata object, including deps and defs.

builtins.name: test
builtins.description: True if the regex matches the input string.

builtins.name: match
builtins.description: Outputs a match object (offset, length, string, captures) for each regex match.

builtins.name: capture
builtins.description: Collects the regex's named captures into an object keyed by capture name.

builtins.name: scan
builtins.description: Emits each non-overlapping regex match as a string, or an array of captured groups if the regex has capturing groups.

builtins.name: splits
builtins.description: Like split(regex; flags) but streams substrings instead of returning an array.

builtins.name: sub
builtins.description: Replaces the first regex match with tostring, which may reference named captures via string interpolation.

builtins.name: gsub
builtins.description: Like sub but replaces all non-overlapping matches.
